meta.title: Reimplement hydration using new diffing/committing architecture
meta.body_summary: Reimplement hydration in src/crank.ts to work with the new diffing/committing separation, enabling parallel sibling hydration, fallback for mismatches, and restoring previously skipped hydration tests.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot reimplemented hydration using diff/commit separation; brainkim requested design changes (remove hydrationData caching and flag), Copilot resolved via explicit parameter passing; maintainer added subsequent fixes and unskipped tests, merged after ~9h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 588 changed lines across 5 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume. It represents a focused framework refactor that aligns with a performance-oriented feature reimplementation (hydration), and the merge after a few review rounds is consistent with moderate complexity.

review_details.concern_detail: brainkim questioned the need for caching hydrationData on Retainer and using IsHydrating flag, suggesting to pass hydration data explicitly during the commit phase; Copilot implemented the change.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable hydration with new architecture, improving performance via parallel sibling hydration and removing serial requirement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex framework-level refactor (hydration, diff/commit architecture) requires deep understanding of Crank internals; Copilot handled the initial implementation but required design guidance from maintainer to align with preferred patterns.

detection_detail.code_reading: brainkim manually reviewed the code, questioned caching and flag patterns, and suggested explicit parameter passing; no profiler or CI-based detection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Test file hydration.tsx unskipped and passed; PR includes manual testing instructions but no benchmark.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: During review, Copilot removed hydrationData caching and IsHydrating flag as per maintainer request; maintainer added lint, fixes, and unskipped additional tests before merge.

core_change_summary.description: In src/crank.ts, reimplemented Renderer.hydrate() to integrate with diffChildren/commitChildren architecture, removed commented-out old code, added hydration data flow via explicit parameters; updated src/dom.ts and test/hydration.tsx to unskip and fix hydration tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The main implementation changes are in crank.ts and dom.ts; test changes unskip hydration tests and adjust refs.
